clips.title: The story
paras: Your search for the Tome of the Cabal leads from Ironforge to a lost manuscript and a sunken ship. Its scattered pages hold rites for binding a felhunter.

Only one copy of the Tome of the Cabal was ever written, and violence left it in pieces. Its remnants were torn apart, defaced, and scattered to distant corners of the world. A tattered manuscript, ripped from the binding, crossed the sea to Kalimdor and fell into the hands of centaur clans. The other section was sent by sea from Lordaeron toward Khaz Modan, but its vessel sank before reaching port.

The missing pages lie beyond two dangers. Pages lost at sea washed ashore on the Hillsbrad coast, west of Southshore, where shoreline murlocs near Azurelode Mine took the waterlogged relics and wreckage. The dry half lies in Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles, deep in centaur caverns, inside an ancient chest. Once the pieces are together, Krom Stoutarm can inspect the lost text before it returns to Strahad Farsan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It was lost, but there's some idea as to where it might be found.

There was only one copy ever made and it was vandalized at some point, a large portion of it ripped from the binding. Rumor has it that it somehow passed into the hands of the centaur of Thousand Needles.
The rest was lost off the coast west of Southshore, where it was to be transported to Menethil Harbor by boat. It never arrived.
In exchange for this knowledge, all I ask is that if you find it, bring it to me to see.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did the rumors prove true, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic! Now I may join the ranks of the few that have spied its contents.
I can't wait to further peruse this text. This is a great day, friend! If you will just allow me to glance at it before you leave. I'm sure that Strahad will be willing to send me a copy.
